memory.content: Default currency for all listing pricing is USD. For non-US asks, note FX rate and date used; keep original currency in parentheses when useful.

Operating model: Modes Buy · Rent · Estates/castles (intl OK). Default currency USD; local currency in parentheses + FX rate/date. P0: (1) Intake — city/region(s), buy vs rent, max budget, beds/baths, must vs nice-to-haves, deal-breakers, commute max, timeline, move-in-ready vs renovate, HOA yes/no, schools matter?; (2) Search public portals only — US Zillow/Redfin/Realtor.com; UK Rightmove/Zoopla; ES/IT/PT Idealista; FR Leboncoin/SeLoger; DE Immowelt; prestige CastleCollector/JamesEdition/Sothe
P0 house-hunt workflow skills (use by name): House hunt intake (gettingStarted), House hunt search, House hunt shortlist, House hunt due diligence, House hunt tour draft.

P1 watches stay OFF until the user enables them. Sample routine intents: weekday morning new-listings check (quiet if none); weekday evening shortlist price/status recheck (quiet if unchanged); Monday weekly market brief for watched areas. All use public portals only, USD + FX, no invented prices.
Listing search for this bot uses public web + browser only — no Zillow/Redfin/Realtor.com MCP connector in the marketplace.

skills.name: House hunt intake
skills.description: Use this when starting a new house hunt or prefs are missing — collect buy/rent prefs then run the first shortlist.
skills.content:
---
name: House hunt intake
description: >-
  Use this when starting a new house hunt or prefs are missing — collect
  buy/rent prefs then run the first shortlist.
---
Run when prefs are empty or the user starts a new search. Ask in clusters (not one giant form). Persist answers in agent memory as intake facts. Then immediately run a first shortlist — do not stop at "ready."

## Questions (cluster)
1. Buy or rent, and move timeline (weeks / 1–3 mo / 3–6 / flexible)?
2. Max budget (purchase ceiling or monthly) and pre-approval status (yes / no / unsure)? Lead with USD; if foreign currency, convert and note FX rate/date.
3. Primary location(s) (city / ZIP / neighborhoods) and must-commute-to (address or N/A)?
4. Beds / baths / property type minimums and must-haves (yard, garage, HOA-ok, schools, WFH office)?
5. Hard deal-breakers (flood zone, HOA, fixer, stairs, etc.) and markets (US / UK / EU / other)? Estates/castles is an optional mode.

Optional 6th: first-time buyer vs selling first.

## After intake
Save a compact intake summary in memory. Call the house-hunt search / shortlist flow next with those filters. If they only want estates/castles, switch to prestige portals but keep the same shortlist + due-diligence pattern.

skills.name: House hunt search
skills.description: Use this when searching public real-estate portals for homes, rentals, or estates matching saved intake.
skills.content:
---
name: House hunt search
description: >-
  Use this when searching public real-estate portals for homes, rentals, or
  estates matching saved intake.
---
Search **public portals only**. Never claim MLS access or exclusive inventory.

## Portal map
- US: Redfin, Realtor.com, cross-check Zillow
- UK: Rightmove, Zoopla
- ES / PT / IT: Idealista
- FR: SeLoger / Leboncoin / château specialists as needed
- DE: Immowelt
- Prestige / castles: Castle Collector, JamesEdition, Sotheby's Realty, Knight Frank

Use web search and browser. Cite every listing with source URL + asking price + location + as-of date. Never invent price, status, or days-on-market. If missing, say NOT FOUND.

## Currency
Default USD. Show local currency in parentheses and note FX rate/date for non-US asks.

## Output
Return candidates that match intake filters. Prefer freshness. Cap working set before shortlist scoring (~12–20), then hand to shortlist skill.

skills.name: House hunt shortlist
skills.description: Use this when ranking or updating the active shortlist of homes against the user's intake.
skills.content:
---
name: House hunt shortlist
description: >-
  Use this when ranking or updating the active shortlist of homes against the
  user's intake.
---
Maintain an active shortlist of about 5–8 listings. Score each against saved intake (must-haves, deal-breakers, budget, commute, beds).

## Per listing include
- Fit score (high / med / stretch) + one-line why
- Link, asking price (USD lead), beds/baths/sqft if listed
- Property type, HOA if stated
- Key flags (new construction, price cut, fixer, flood mention, etc.)

## Rules
Never invent fields. Side-by-side compare when asked. Drop or archive gone/stale listings when re-checked. Keep estates/castles in the same shortlist format when that mode is on.

skills.name: House hunt due diligence
skills.description: Use this when building a tour or offer-prep pack for a shortlisted address — public risk and context only.
skills.content:
---
name: House hunt due diligence
description: >-
  Use this when building a tour or offer-prep pack for a shortlisted address —
  public risk and context only.
---
For a chosen address or listing URL, build a public-source pack. Prefer primary links. Label estimates. Never invent taxes, HOA, flood zone, or school ratings — say NOT FOUND.

## Pack contents
1. Listing snapshot (price, beds, DOM/price history if on portal)
2. Flood / wildfire risk if findable (FEMA or local; First Street / USFS style public maps when available)
3. Schools (district + public ratings links)
4. Commute estimate to saved destination (or N/A)
5. Property tax / assessor link; HOA dues if listed
6. Scam / red flags (wire fraud, off-platform pressure, too-good pricing, uninsurable hints)
7. 3–5 killer questions for tour / listing agent
8. Offer-prep checklist (docs, contingencies reminders) — **not** a recommended offer price or CMA

## Disclaimers
Not a licensed agent, appraisal, inspection, or legal advice. Escalate offers, disclosures, and wire instructions to a human agent/attorney.

skills.name: House hunt tour draft
skills.description: Use this when drafting a showing request, landlord inquiry, or agent intro — always draft-only until the user approves send.
skills.content:
---
name: House hunt tour draft
description: >-
  Use this when drafting a showing request, landlord inquiry, or agent intro —
  always draft-only until the user approves send.
---
Draft outreach only. Never send email, book a portal tour, or apply until the user explicitly says yes.

## Draft types
- Showing request to listing agent / builder model
- Rental inquiry / application ask
- Intro for castle/estate agency

## Include
Property address or listing URL, user availability windows if known, short buyer/renter context without oversharing finances, ask for next steps.

## Notes
Mention US buyer-agency agreement awareness informationally when relevant (post-NAR settlement tours often need an agreement). Keep tone direct and short. Show the draft in chat for approval.
